one_line_contribution: Plant two explicit, task-irrelevant markers (a fixed five-token thought prefix and a leading 'look' action) into ALFWorld expert walkthroughs for three of five task types, then measure how far each marker travels into the weights relative to how far the task content travels (a 'generalization ratio' on unmarked and procedure-held-out types), under SFT, on-policy reverse-KL self-distillation and marker-stripped SFT, plus how fast each decays under one further epoch of clean training.
closest_prior_work: VERIFIED: arXiv:2604.15559, 'Subliminal Transfer of Unsafe Behaviors in AI Agent Distillation' (2026-04-16, 4 citations, s2 channel) — the same substrate (agent-trajectory distillation), the same phenomenon (a task-irrelevant behaviour riding the trajectories into the student), and already the explicit claim that data sanitation is an insufficient defence. The proposal correctly identifies it and differentiates on three axes (scope-vs-content, decay, on-policy objective), so it is not a collision; but it does reduce the contribution to 'add two measurement axes to an existing setting', and the proposal's P3 is framed as contradicting it while actually testing something else (see objection). Also verified and relevant: arXiv:2507.14805 (subliminal learning, 99 cit), arXiv:2606.00831 'Subliminal Learning is a LoRA Artifact' (2026-05-30, s2, 4 cit), arXiv:2606.22019 (channel location / auditability, 2 cit), arXiv:2609.01091 (trait-direction drift, 2026-09-01), arXiv:2601.18734 (OPSD, 'Self-Distilled Reasoner', hf), arXiv:2607.21051 (Experience Distillation, s2). NOT VERIFIED: arXiv:2603.09517, which the Related Work leans on twice (as the natural-language-transfer counterweight to the LoRA-artefact claim, and as the rationale for the mismatched-memory ablation), returned 'not found on S2 or HF'; I could not check it further because WebSearch is unavailable this session. An ID that carries part of the novelty argument and does not resolve on either channel is a defect the authors must fix. A closer conceptual threat I know only from memory and could not verify here is the superficial-alignment / style-is-learned-first line (LIMA and its successors), which already establishes that surface format is acquired broadly from few SFT examples while capability stays narrow; label that unverified.
strongest_objection: Both halves of the title are close to entailed by the construction, which is exactly the brief's 'no prediction entailed by a definition' rule. (a) Scope: S_sft trains only on marked-type targets, so every thought in the training set begins with the phrase and every episode begins with 'look'. Nothing in that data ties either marker to task type, so the model has no signal from which to type-condition it; gamma_marker close to 1 is not generalization, it is unconditional emission of a feature that was unconditional in the data. Meanwhile the content is type-dependent by construction — a clean_then_place procedure cannot execute a pick_two_obj_and_place goal — so gamma_content near 0 on the held-out type is likewise given. P1's headline contrast therefore cannot come out any other way. (b) Decay: the continuation epoch is on clean rollouts of the unmarked types, i.e. data in which the phrase never appears at thought-start and 'look' is rarely the first action. That is direct negative evidence against the markers, while the marked-type content receives only indirect interference. 'Style decays faster than content' is then a statement about which feature the continuation data contradicts, not about a property of dispositions. (c) P3 is a third instance: stripping the phrase and the leading look from the teacher trajectories removes the very string whose emission rate is the outcome measure, so S_sanit adoption <= 0.1 x S_sft is near-automatic and does not test the trajectory-dynamics channel of 2604.15559 at all — that channel is defined for traits *not literally present* in the data. A null there is also confounded with power: the only training regime available is QLoRA, which 2606.00831 (verified) says is where subliminal effects live but at rank-dependent strength, and the proposal admits full fine-tuning of the 32B backbone is infeasible. Secondary but serious: gamma_marker and gamma_content are ratios of incommensurable quantities (a bounded adoption fraction versus net points per 100 with a base-model-dependent ceiling on the held-out type), so 'style outruns content' compares numbers that cannot be put on one scale. And P5 tests 2606.00831's inverted-U-in-rank claim, which was made about subliminal transfer, using an explicit marker — a claim nobody made.
what_would_fix_it: Make type-conditioning learnable, then the scope claim becomes a finding. Train S_sft on a target set containing both marked types (marked) and unmarked types (clean), so the data supports conditioning the marker on type; add a positive control with a different marker per marked type showing the model does condition when the data permits it. Only then does gamma_marker >= 0.7 mean anything. Make the decay test symmetric: continue on data that is neutral with respect to the markers (or that contradicts a content feature to the same degree), rather than on data whose every item is a counter-example to both markers; otherwise report the result as 'direct negative evidence erases a surface feature fast', which is a much smaller claim. Replace the literal-string outcome in S_sanit with a downstream behavioural correlate that is not present as a token in the sanitized data (e.g. a shift in exploration rate or step budget that co-occurs with the planted look), which is the only way to probe the hidden channel that 2604.15559 asserts. Put style and content on one scale — e.g. both as the fraction of the Gate-0 in-context effect retained memory-free — instead of dividing an adoption fraction by a net-points figure. Drop the rank ladder and the verbal-only/action-only interaction arms to bring the budget back inside the stated three days. Finally, resolve or remove arXiv:2603.09517.
missing_baseline: A mixed-target SFT arm in which marked and unmarked task types are both present in the training targets (marked types carrying the markers, unmarked types clean). Without it there is no condition under which the marker could have been type-confined, so 'the marker generalizes to unmarked and held-out types' measures unconditional emission rather than generalization, and P1 cannot be falsified by any outcome. A reviewer will also demand the paired positive control — a type-distinct marker showing the backbone can bind a surface feature to task type at this data scale — before accepting gamma_marker >= 0.7 as evidence of anything about dispositions.
preprint_collision: No verified collision. The proposal's own check is above average for this round: four queries with channels, IDs, and honest 'empty' reports rather than empty-equals-novel reasoning. My own searches (all answered by channel (a), the s2cli command; WebSearch was unavailable and not used, WebFetch never used): (1) 'subliminal learning trait transfer distillation hidden signals in data' --recent → 2609.01091, 2608.26958, 2608.05734, 2606.22019, 2606.00995, 2605.29557, 2605.12798, 2604.25783, 2507.14805 (99 cit) plus the Nature version; (2) 'how far does a fine-tuned style or persona trait generalize compared to task skill out-of-distribution' (no --recent) → persona/OCEAN and emergent-misalignment work only (2607.07916, 2604.28082, 2302.06600); nothing measuring trait scope against content scope from the same items; (3) 'planted behavior marker agent trajectories distillation sanitization data filtering insufficient defense' --recent → 2604.15559 again, plus agent-security work (2608.03700, 2606.02540, 2601.05504) that is not the same claim; (4) 'persistence and decay of implanted behavioral trait under continued fine-tuning on clean data half-life' --recent → only generic forgetting/drift work (2510.13928 Brain Rot, 2507.05386, 2605.09640, 2601.04170); trait durability is genuinely empty, matching the proposal's Query 8; (5) 'subliminal learning survives natural language paraphrase full finetuning not just numbers' --recent → 2606.00995, 2604.25783, 2510.13900, 2507.14805 — notably it did NOT surface 2603.09517; (6) 'does on-policy distillation or reinforcement learning transmit teacher behavioral traits or filter them out' --recent → a dense on-policy-distillation literature (2608.31046, 2608.16647 'dual nature of generalization in on-policy distillation' — behaviours transfer rather than answers, 2608.19408, 2604.00626 survey) but none of it about task-irrelevant dispositions. Verification: 2604.15559, 2606.00831, 2601.18734, 2607.21051 confirmed by `paper`; 2507.14805, 2606.22019, 2606.00995, 2609.01091, 2608.26958 confirmed as search hits; 2603.09517 NOT FOUND on either channel and could not be checked further without WebSearch. Two gaps in the proposal's check: it misses 2608.05734 'Subliminal Learning is Non-Semantic Distillation' (2026-08-06) and 2604.25783 'Subliminal Steering' (2026-04-28), both directly on the channel question its S_sanit arm probes, and 2608.16647 (2026-08-17), which already reports that on-policy distillation transfers behaviours rather than answers — adjacent to P2's premise. None of these makes the scope-versus-content or decay claim, so the novelty of the framing survives; the deduction is for a load-bearing unresolvable ID and for three recent preprints the check should have caught.
